REBALANCED_SPIRE_FIRST_TIME_FTUE_DESCRIP:
Welcome to the Rebalanced Spire mod!

Since Slay the Spire 2 is still in Early Access, its balance is not yet in its best state. Because of this, we have made a number of adjustments to certain monsters, events, relics, cards, and other in-game content in the hope of improving the overall gameplay experience.

With the default settings, the game will be somewhat easier. To better accommodate different player preferences, we have also prepared a wide range of mod configuration options so players can customize the experience themselves!
REBALANCED_SPIRE_FIRST_TIME_FTUE_DISCLAI:
Note:
Our goal is to fix problems, not remove the fun.
